description.value: The Wild Turkey Inn is a restored 1890 Victorian heritage home in Rossland, BC, originally commissioned for the first Bank of Montreal manager in town during the height of the Red Mountain gold rush, and still showcasing eleven-foot ceilings, original fir floors, and period craftsmanship. Offered exclusively as a whole-house private stay for groups and families, it sits three blocks from downtown Rossland and ten minutes from RED Mountain Ski Resort, in a town that has reinvented itself as a Western Canadian hub for skiing and mountain biking. Owner-hosts Shauna and Mike live on site and are available to share local knowledge, making it a characterful and personal base for exploring the Kootenays.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is available and detailed. The front page explicitly lists 'access to secure ski, bike, and gear storage' as an included amenity, confirming secure overnight bike storage. On-site laundry is also explicitly mentioned on the front page. No specific mention of staff bike-handling procedures, Wi-Fi, e-bike charging, pump, tools, drying area, or bike wash was found in any of the fetched pages; complimentary breakfast items are described as a self-serve pantry setup rather than an early or packed breakfast service.
concerns: OSM tag 'was:name: Sweet Dreams Heritage Inn' indicates a prior business name; the current name 'The Wild Turkey Inn' is confirmed by the website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-documented accommodation with explicit secure bike and gear storage in a major BC mountain biking and cycling destination; a clear fit for the WWC directory.
